title.narrative: GCF Readiness III - New DAEs, Carbon Policy and Subnational Climate Finance

description.narrative: This Readiness proposal aims to act on the abovementioned problems around four of the objectives of the GCF’s Readiness Programme (1. Capacity building, 2. Strategic frameworks, 4. Pipeline development and 5. Knowledge sharing and learning).

This is a multi-year proposal submitted alongside Mexico's NDA (Ministry of Finance) to support the accreditation of 2 new Direct Access Entities (DAEs; FIRA and NADB), develop inputs towards a national carbon policy plus catalyze private investments at the subnational level through climate smart PPPs and thematic bonds.This idea aligns to GGGI’s Strategy 2030 and Mexico Country Business Plan 2021-25 (waste, climate finance, climate action).
